target.title: fix(memory-wiki): salvage human Notes before pruning imported source pages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102230 — when `pruneImportedSourceEntries` removes a page whose syncKey
legitimately left `activeKeys`, it force-deletes the page file including the
human-authored `## Notes` block with no salvage, archive, or tombstone.

## Root Cause

`pruneImportedSourceEntries` calls `fs.rm` with no read of the page content
and no check for the human Notes block. Normal syncs protect Notes via
`preserveHumanNotesBlock`, but the prune path bypasses preservation entirely.

## Fix

Before removing the page, read it and extract the human Notes block. If
present, write it to `.salvage/<page>.notes.md` in the vault root before
proceeding with removal.

28 lines in `extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync-state.ts`.

## Evidence

### End-to-End Proof — production function

```
node --import tsx -e 'import { pruneImportedSourceEntries }...'

BEFORE prune:
  page exists: yes
  salvage dir exists: no

AFTER prune (removed: 1 pages):
  page exists: no
  salvage file: .salvage/sources_test.md.notes.md
  salvaged content:
<!-- openclaw:human:start -->
These are my durable annotations that should survive.
<!-- openclaw:human:end -->
```

### Regression Tests

3 tests in `extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync-state.test.ts`:
- `"salvages human Notes before pruning an imported page"` — verifies Notes
  survive in `.salvage/` after prune
- `"does not create salvage files for pages without human Notes"` — no
  unnecessary salvage dirs
- `"prunes pages even when the page file is already missing"` — missing page
  doesn't block cleanup

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync-state.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)  Tests  7 passed (7)
```

### Autoreview

```
python .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.95)
```

## Change Type / Scope / Security Impact

- **Change type**: `fix` — data-loss bug: prune silently destroys human Notes
- **Scope**: memory-wiki plugin only (`extensions/memory-wiki/src/`)
- **Security**: No new permissions, no secrets handling changes, no network
  calls. Filesystem writes limited to `.salvage/` under the vault root with
  sanitized filenames (`/` → `_`). The `entry.pagePath` is from internal
  state, not user input.

- [x] oxfmt + oxlint pass
- [x] git diff --check pass
- [x] autoreview clean
